functions.description: Text line wrapping with escape tags
functions.notes: Size and shape match (0x5b8). Remaining 124 bytes: (1) the str r8,[sp,#0x2c] width store is emitted after the argument moves instead of right after the preceding store, in the prologue and in the four line-reset blocks (reordering source statements has no effect); (2) step and advance registers are swapped (target step=r6, advance=fp; ours step=fp, advance=r6), so the glyph block entry/key/size temporaries rotate (declaration order, function-scope declarations and colorsweep made no change); (3) the limit+lineExtra vs width+advance compare loads width first. Closed levers: non-short-circuit strstr pair, switch(r) for the tag handler result, glyphIndex=-1 before advance=0, dst=markDst before memset.
